title: Move RFC 5322/MIME writer from jmap-mime to mime-tree
description: Mark 2026-10-23: JMAP-u6c5 lands a general RFC 5322/MIME message writer inside crate-jmap-mime. Writing messages is not JMAP-specific; it belongs in mime-tree (github.com/MarkAtwood/crate-mime, ~/PROJECT path TBD), next to its parser. Move the generic writer module there, release mime-tree, then make jmap-mime a thin JMAP Email-create -> writer mapping depending on the new mime-tree. Coordinate the mime-tree release with crate-jmap's version bump.
